Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are often built by (1) pretraining on paired image-caption datasets and (2) subsequent finetuning on image-instruction data on diverse vision-language (VL) tasks.
outputs: Generated text responses to visual inputs (images and instructions)
generated answers, captions, and dialogue responses to visual prompts

quote: we compute average relative performance, denoted as Rel., across benchmarks to assess the level of generalization.

We compute average relative performance, denoted as Rel., across benchmarks to assess the level of generalization. Each relative performance is derived from the formula: (model performance / full-finetuned performance) × 100%.

we evaluate the models on several widely adopted zero-shot multimodal evaluation benchmarks, including 1) visual question answering: VQAv2, GQA, VizWiz; 2) knowledge-grounded QA: ScienceQA; 3) Optical Character Recognition (OCR): TextVQA; 4) hallucination: POPE; 5) multiple-choice: MME, MM-Bench; 6) free-form generation: LLaVA-Bench, MM-Vet.
